text: I don't have a preference. Use the defaults you recommend, keep it free with no API keys, and carry on without me.
reply_text:
Done. Everything is installed, wired, and verified with real round-trips.

What's installed
- gbrain 0.60.734.0 → /harness-state/.bun/bin/gbrain, on PATH via ~/.bashrc. Keyless PGLite brain at /harness-state/.gbrain (no server, no API keys, BM25 keyword search).
- Bun 1.4.4+ at /harness-state/.bun/bin/bun (gbrain requires it).
- Pinned at 734.0 as you asked. Channel is `stable`, so `gbrain upgrade` won't move you past your pin until you say so.

Connected to Hermes
- MCP: `gbrain` registered in /harness-state/hermes/config.yaml as stdio `serve --surface starter --advertise verbs`. `hermes mcp test gbrain` → connected, 8 tools (remember, recall, entity, forget, context_pack, delta, synthesize, request_tools).
- Per-turn rule: `pre_llm_call` hook in config.yaml, allowlisted and smoke-tested green (`hermes hooks doctor`: valid JSON, 0.021s). This is the part that makes the agent actually consult the brain — the SOUL.md block alone only reaches the system prompt.
- Brain-first block appended to SOUL.md (marked, reversible via `gbrain setup hermes --instructions-only --no-instructions`).
- 129 skill files scaffolded to /workspace/skills/ and registered via `skills.external_dirs`; `hermes skills list` shows them loaded (brain-ops, capture, query, gbrain-advisor, etc.).

Verified
- `gbrain remember "gbrain install check"` → fact #1; `recall` returned it; `forget 1` → `recall` returns nothing. Real write/read/withdraw round trip.
- `gbrain doctor`: 80/100, all checks OK with warnings (0/35 embed, 0/25 links — expected on a keyless empty brain).

Three things worth knowing
- `gbrain bootstrap verify` reports FAILs on `byte_floors`, `writeback_contract`, `roundtrip` (file write-through). Those belong to gbrain's private-repo *identity bootstrap* path, which its own docs say to skip unless you ask for a new personal agent with identity files and a repo. I skipped it deliberately. The memory-only path is verified by the doctor score plus the remember/recall round trip above. Say the word if you want the full bootstrap.
- Ordering bug in gbrain: `skillpack scaffold` needs a gbrain repo root, so I cloned the tag to /harness-state/gbrain-src (806MB). It's also what `gbrain skillpack reference --all` will need later to diff skill drift. Removable with `rm -rf /harness-state/gbrain-src` if you don't care about skill updates.
- Backups of the two files I touched are in /harness-state/gbrain-backup/ (config.yaml, SOUL.md as they were before setup). The MCP entry and hook are both additive; `gbrain setup hermes --remove` undoes the brain-first pieces.

Nothing is scheduled — no cron jobs, no enrichment, no paid calls. The research extensions gbrain ships (exa/tavily/firecrawl/perplexity) are present as skills but dormant; they need their own keys and I left them alone.
